title: Execution of the configuration scan
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and work-tape symbols, and fix any codec mode. Let $y,x,w,r$ be finite bit strings with $y$ equal to the self-delimiting pair encoding of $x$ and the pair encoding of $w$ with $r$. Let $R$ be a register assignment whose 21 register values are all at most $B=(8W_N+8)(|y|+1)$, and suppose its registers $A$ and $E$ have values $2|x|+2$ and $2|x|+2+4W_Ns+2W_N$, respectively. If $W_N(2s+1)|w|$, then there is an accumulator state whose scan component equals the result of scanning the first $W_N(2s+1)$ bits of $w$, and the codec program in the chosen mode can reach its completion state from the register state obtained by clearing $Q_1$, while keeping every register at most $B$ throughout the run; at completion, registers $Q_1$ and $Q_2$ both equal the original value of $E$.

$y,x,w,r$ are finite bit strings and $s$ is a natural number
$y$ is the prescribed nested pair encoding of $x,w,r$
Every register value in $R$ is at most $(8W_N+8)(|y|+1)$
